decisions.reason: The medical examination light builds on established competencies and serves institutional customers, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations and slack from an expanding firm, there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The explosion-proof luminaire line extends the core industrial business with several models in a growing industry, so it likely meets aspirations and remains a strategic fit.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the core offer, but by 2022 it is ageing, so a successor model is plausible even though nothing indicates a shortfall yet.
The pendant office luminaire is close to the core LED office business and was launched recently, so management keeps it while results are still forming, as slack allows.
The premium pendant line with several models sits close to the established offer and fits the energy-efficient LED strategy, so with no sign of underperformance it stays.
